name: The Stroke of Midnight
source:
Rowan Cox wakes up in a barren room, alone with a mysterious girl he's never seen before. He quickly comes to realise that things are very much out of place.
After the prologue, the world is in political turmoil, with major figures dropping dead like flies. Rowan joins his friend's detective agency, and is dragged feet-first into the troubles.

[From [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=43&t=27507]Lemmasoft thread[/url]]
